column1: # The GitHub runner's stored runs made after the laptop arrived, each kept on the record with its reason (Sprint 373; docs/postmortem-windows-runs-off-the-laptop-2026-11-27.md, "What the wrong machine reached"): run, family, the sprint whose commit stored it, reason. Read by crates/windows_machine/tests/reference_machine.rs, which passes a stored run off the laptop only when it is a runner's run with id at most 38311779649 (the last runner run of 2026-10-12, before the laptop arrived; the user's decision of 2026-10-11, "the runners' existing rows stay on the record") or a row here, and fails a row that names no stored runner run after that id. From Sprint 374 each reason names the laptop run its family is held to and the comparison's outcome (crates/windows_machine/tests/runner_families_on_the_laptop.rs), or why the family keeps this run
